data.one_liner: Automatically generates asset configs in YAML and Dart constants for single projects and modules.
data.what_it_does: The tool scans asset folders and automatically updates pubspec.yaml configurations. It also generates Dart constant classes to reference your assets safely across your application.
use_when: You want to avoid manually typing asset paths in pubspec.yaml
You want type-safe constants for accessing assets in Flutter
avoid_when: You prefer manually managing asset entries and strings
strengths: Generates Dart constants with customizable naming rules
weaknesses: Requires global tool activation and path configuration
Relies on external CLI execution rather than a build_runner dependency
data.setup_notes: Activate globally via pub and add the pub bin path to your system path.
